title: Act: Implement loadManifestFile with on-disk reference check
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid manifest and files, when called, then returns ok with data
Given a missing file or bad JSON, when called, then returns issues and does not throw

steps.action: Export loadManifestFile(manifestPath: string, assetsRoot: string): ParseResult<AssetManifest>. Wrap readFileSync and JSON.parse in try/catch returning {ok:false,errors:[{path:'manifest',message:`cannot read manifest: ${manifestPath}`}]}. Call parseManifest; if not ok return it. Then for each asset index i, if !existsSync(join(assetsRoot, asset.path)) push {path:`assets.${i}.path`, message:`missing asset file: ${asset.path}`}. Return {ok:false,errors} if any, else {ok:true,data}.
steps.code: import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import { parseManifest, type ParseResult, type ManifestIssue, type AssetManifest } from '../manifest';
